title: Democrats win at least 258 US House seats, their biggest majority since 1992
caption:
Democrats have won at least 258 seats in the US House of Representatives, their largest majority since 1992, the AP says. The mark was reached on Sunday when Democrat Chuck Hubbard defeated Republican Virginia Foxx in North Carolina. Democrats also control the Senate with 56 seats, and Hakeem Jeffries is set to become House speaker in January. President Trump keeps his veto power.
